# Top 100 Stata command evidence matrix

## 판정 기준

- `0 direct-policy`는 별도 guide template quota가 필요 없는 언어 primitive 또는 직접 진단 계약이다.
- `1 simple`은 비직접 material contract를 한 개의 비중복 guide atom으로 충분히 덮는다.
- `N multiple`은 입력·문법·추정·추론·returned state·handoff가 달라 여러 guide atom이 필요하다.
- 논문 실제 코드는 registry token/command anchor로 그룹 문맥에만 연결한다. exact contract template support로 승격하지 않는다.
- 코드 비공개 research usage만 명시 `contract_ids`가 있을 때 exact/occurrence support로 별도 표시한다.
- 아래 guide와 legacy paper code block은 source span readback으로 검증한 전체 원문을 `<details><pre>`에 보존한다.
- code-free research usage는 원문 코드가 없으므로 exact/occurrence support와 group context만 표시한다.

## 검증 요약

- rows: 100; material contracts: 395
- guide-required/direct-policy contracts: 376/19
- declared guide gaps: 1; legacy paper code mapped/unmapped: 96/13
- complete raw code ledger: guide blocks 454; legacy paper blocks 109
- registry requirements hash match: `true`

treatment == 1 &#10;egen tot_study_1 = total(tot_study_temp) if c_voter_section_no_ != ., by(c_mun_id c_voter_section_no_)&#10;label variable tot_study_1 &quot;Respondents&quot;&#10;&#10;gen tot_control_by_section_1 = tot_study_1 - tot_treatment_by_section_1&#10;&#10;&#10;** COUNTING NUMBER OF TREATED UNITS WITH CLIENTELIST RELATIONSHIP IN A GIVEN SECTION	&#10;gen treat_frequent = treatment * frequent_interactor&#10;label var treat_frequent &quot;Treatment $\times$ Clientelist Relationship&quot;&#10;						&#10;gen treat_talk_temp = 1 if frequent_interactor == 1 &amp; treatment == 1&#10;egen tot_treat_talk_by_section_1 = total(treat_talk_temp), by(c_mun_id c_voter_section_no_)&#10;label variable tot_treat_talk_by_section_1 &quot;Treated Individuals with Clientelist Relationship&quot;&#10;&#10;drop treat_talk_temp&#10;&#10;&#10;** COUNTING NUMBER OF CTRL UNITS WITH CLIENTELIST RELATIONSHIP IN A GIVEN SECTION &#10;gen ctrl_talk_temp = 1 if frequent_interactor == 1 &amp; treatment == 0&#10;egen tot_ctrl_talk_by_section_1 = total(ctrl_talk_temp), by(c_mun_id c_voter_section_no_)&#10;label variable tot_ctrl_talk_by_section_1 &quot;Number of Control People Interact Often with Politician&quot;&#10;&#10;gen tot_study_frequent_1 = tot_treat_talk_by_section_1 + tot_ctrl_talk_by_section_1&#10;label variable tot_study_frequent_1 &quot;Respondents with Clientelist Relationship&quot;&#10;&#10;drop ctrl_talk_temp&#10;&#10;&#10;** COUNTING NUMBER OF TREATED UNITS WITHOUT A CLIENTELIST RELATIONSHIP IN A GIVEN SECTION&#10;gen treat_talk_temp = 1 if frequent_interactor == 0 &amp; treatment == 0&#10;egen tot_ctrl_not_talk_by_section_1 = count(ctrl_talk_temp), by(c_mun_id c_voter_section_no_)&#10;label variable tot_ctrl_not_talk_by_section_1 &quot;Number of Control People Not Interact Often with Politician&quot;&#10;&#10;gen tot_study_infrequent_1 = tot_treat_not_talk_by_section_1 + tot_ctrl_not_talk_by_section_1&#10;label variable tot_study_infrequent_1 &quot;Respondents without Clientelist Relationship&quot;&#10;&#10;drop ctrl_talk_temp&#10;&#10;&#10;** As of now, the voting data includes unadjusted regressors, but not adjusted ones&#10;replace mun_id = c_mun_id&#10;save &quot;${gen_data_folder}/voting_data_unadjusted.dta&quot;, replace&#10;</pre></details><br><details><summary><code>figure.event_study_csdid_event_plot.v1 [reference_only]</code></summary><small>source=corpus/packages/175582/Code/ado/e/five_estimators_example.do:57-64; source_kind=deposited_research_code_source_pattern; source_sha256=9092710a972900367d449c2f06c7916f4e22f1a4ff6ae2e9a171333c85921ec1; code_sha256=b3fc67120f3ff6d510f32d79f61deeba15996c59c6d3e04045770edb5c902f42</small><pre>// Estimation with cldid of Callaway and Sant&#x27;Anna (2020)&#10;gen gvar = cond(Ei==., 0, Ei) // group variable as required for the csdid command&#10;timer on 3&#10;csdid Y, ivar(i) time(t) gvar(gvar) notyet&#10;estat event, estore(cs) // this produces and stores the estimates at the same time&#10;timer off 3&#10;event_plot cs, default_look graph_opt(xtitle(&quot;Periods since the event&quot;) ytitle(&quot;Average causal effect&quot;) xlabel(-9(1)4) ///&#10;	title(&quot;Callaway and Sant&#x27;Anna (2020)&quot;)) stub_lag(E#) stub_lead(E_#) together&#10;</pre></details><br><details><summary><code>figure.event_study_sun_abraham_event_plot.v1 [reference_only]</code></summary><small>source=corpus/packages/175582/Code/ado/e/five_estimators_example.do:66-80; source_kind=deposited_research_code_source_pattern; source_sha256=9092710a972900367d449c2f06c7916f4e22f1a4ff6ae2e9a171333c85921ec1; code_sha256=58699ab849c5f7117846cda69438993397533160c67e61b937b1391c215b906e</small><pre>// Estimation with eventstudyinteract of Sun and Abraham (2020)&#10;sum Ei&#10;gen lastcohort = Ei==r(max) // dummy for the latest- or never-treated cohort&#10;forvalues l = 0/5 {&#10;	gen L`l&#x27;event = K==`l&#x27;&#10;}&#10;forvalues l = 1/14 {&#10;	gen F`l&#x27;event = K==-`l&#x27;&#10;}&#10;drop F1event // normalize K=-1 (and also K=-15) to zero&#10;timer on 4&#10;eventstudyinteract Y L*event F*event, vce(cluster i) absorb(i t) cohort(Ei) control_cohort(lastcohort)&#10;timer off 4&#10;event_plot e(b_iw)#e(V_iw), default_look graph_opt(xtitle(&quot;Periods since the event&quot;) ytitle(&quot;Average causal effect&quot;) xlabel(-9(1)4) ///&#10;	title(&quot;Sun and Abraham (2020)&quot;)) stub_lag(L#event) stub_lead(F#event) together&#10;</pre></details><br><details><summary><code>input.combine.sequential_import_append.v1 [reference_only]</code></summary><small>source=corpus/packages/194561/code/10_data_preparation.do:17-41,43; treatment == 0&#10;egen tot_ctrl_talk_by_section_1 = total(ctrl_talk_temp), by(c_mun_id c_voter_section_no_)&#10;label variable tot_ctrl_talk_by_section_1 &quot;Number of Control People Interact Often with Politician&quot;&#10;&#10;gen tot_study_frequent_1 = tot_treat_talk_by_section_1 + tot_ctrl_talk_by_section_1&#10;label variable tot_study_frequent_1 &quot;Respondents with Clientelist Relationship&quot;&#10;&#10;drop ctrl_talk_temp&#10;&#10;&#10;** COUNTING NUMBER OF TREATED UNITS WITHOUT A CLIENTELIST RELATIONSHIP IN A GIVEN SECTION&#10;gen treat_talk_temp = 1 if frequent_interactor == 0 &amp; treatment == 1&#10;egen tot_treat_not_talk_by_section_1 = total(treat_talk_temp), by(c_mun_id c_voter_section_no_)&#10;label variable tot_treat_not_talk_by_section_1 &quot;Treated Individuals without Clientelist Relationship&quot;&#10;&#10;drop treat_talk_temp&#10;&#10;&#10;** COUNTING NUMBER OF CTRL UNITS WITHOUT A CLIENTELIST RELATIONSHIP IN A GIVEN SECTION&#10;gen ctrl_talk_temp = 1 if frequent_interactor == 0 &amp; source_kind=deposited_research_code_source_pattern; source_sha256=9092710a972900367d449c2f06c7916f4e22f1a4ff6ae2e9a171333c85921ec1; code_sha256=58699ab849c5f7117846cda69438993397533160c67e61b937b1391c215b906e</small><pre>// Estimation with eventstudyinteract of Sun and Abraham (2020)&#10;sum Ei&#10;gen lastcohort = Ei==r(max) // dummy for the latest- or never-treated cohort&#10;forvalues l = 0/5 {&#10;	gen L`l&#x27;event = K==`l&#x27;&#10;}&#10;forvalues l = 1/14 {&#10;	gen F`l&#x27;event = K==-`l&#x27;&#10;}&#10;drop F1event // normalize K=-1 (and also K=-15) to zero&#10;timer on 4&#10;eventstudyinteract Y L*event F*event, vce(cluster i) absorb(i t) cohort(Ei) control_cohort(lastcohort)&#10;timer off 4&#10;event_plot e(b_iw)#e(V_iw), default_look graph_opt(xtitle(&quot;Periods since the event&quot;) ytitle(&quot;Average causal effect&quot;) xlabel(-9(1)4) ///&#10;	title(&quot;Sun and Abraham (2020)&quot;)) stub_lag(L#event) stub_lead(F#event) together&#10;</pre></details><br><details><summary><code>input.combine.sequential_import_append.v1 [reference_only]</code></summary><small>source=corpus/packages/194561/code/10_data_preparation.do:17-41,43; Make sure all gravity covariates, except distance, are set to zero for domestic trade*&#10;******************************************************************************************&#10;local gravvars &quot;CNTG LANG CLNY EU WTO RTA FTA&quot; &#10;foreach x of local gravvars{&#10;replace `x&#x27;=0 if exporter==importer&#10;}&#10;*************************&#10;*d. Check for duplicates*&#10;*************************&#10;duplicates list year exporter importer&#10;*************************************&#10;*e. Create some additional variables*&#10;*************************************	&#10;egen idt_ci = group(exporter year)&#10;egen idt_cj = group(importer year)&#10;egen id_ci_cj = group(exporter importer)&#10;compress&#10;save ${usr_data}\data_large, replace&#10;</pre></details><br><details><summary><code>sample.trade_share_threshold.v1 [reference_only]</code></summary><small>source=corpus/packages/194561/code/10_data_preparation.do:135-151; source_kind=deposited_research_code; source_sha256=28d3bf8bde49cce093ad583a3f62a9089981154fdb71f35892d39a8d9c42cc38; code_sha256=fba0a33bea533832ae9cb0f0e4b82c00c127b52036c1558586b3c406e4072f58</small><pre>use ${usr_data}\data_large.dta, clear&#10;keep if exporter!=importer&#10;collapse (sum) trade, by(exporter)&#10;sort trade&#10;gen sum_trade_cum=sum(trade)&#10;egen sum_trade_all=sum(trade)&#10;gen ratio= sum_trade_cum/sum_trade_all&#10;drop if ratio&lt;0.01&#10;keep exporter&#10;save ${tmp_data}\exp_small.dta, replace&#10;rename exporter importer&#10;save ${tmp_data}\imp_small.dta, replace&#10;use ${usr_data}\data_large.dta, clear&#10;joinby importer using ${tmp_data}\imp_small.dta&#10;joinby exporter using ${tmp_data}\exp_small.dta&#10;keep year exporter importer trade CLNY CNTG LANG DIST RTA_DGD WTO_DGD gdp_pwt_cur_d gdp_pwt_cur_o idt_ci idt_cj id_ci_cj&#10;save ${usr_data}\data_medium.dta, replace&#10;</pre></details><br><details><summary><code>sample.trade_share_threshold_small.v1 [reference_only]</code></summary><small>source=corpus/packages/194561/code/10_data_preparation.do:153-171; source_kind=deposited_research_code; source_sha256=28d3bf8bde49cce093ad583a3f62a9089981154fdb71f35892d39a8d9c42cc38; code_sha256=65d25ded06a2515cfcf05e86f6cc3a5620e55443783cef69525dc5e18c68bd00</small><pre>*g. - <details><summary><code>reporting.estimates_store_restore_paired.v1 [audit_action=retained_no_override]</code></summary><small>source=plugins/stata-research-guard/annotations/source_snapshots/top50_reporting_gap_fill_guide_templates.do:81-85; source_kind=official_stata_manual_derived_mechanics; source_sha256=53bc392f372089c45694467fca9b9ecc3b9122830af36696167be3cc7b4eb643; code_sha256=f233c7ca86be98d6d1791d6145bc703d1df1d65792c386d662a8e2dcc0f6e646</small><pre>* estimates: store one result, change the active result, then restore the declared stored result.&#10;regress y1 treat x1&#10;estimates store model_1&#10;regress y2 treat x1&#10;estimates restore model_1&#10;</pre></details>

- <details><summary><code>reporting.outreg2_coherent_multioutcome.v1 [audit_action=retained_no_override]</code></summary><small>source=plugins/stata-research-guard/annotations/source_snapshots/top50_reporting_gap_fill_guide_templates.do:41-45; source_kind=user_written_command_guide_derived_mechanics; source_sha256=53bc392f372089c45694467fca9b9ecc3b9122830af36696167be3cc7b4eb643; code_sha256=77e1e869c7393767f3384211bd9a4f8a0e045199efda0c9d999a8d14403aa6d7</small><pre>* outreg2: two declared outcomes write ordered native columns to one Excel table.&#10;regress y1 treat x1, vce(cluster cluster_id)&#10;outreg2 using &quot;results/main_table.xlsx&quot;, excel replace ctitle(&quot;Outcome 1&quot;)&#10;regress y2 treat x1, vce(cluster cluster_id)&#10;outreg2 using &quot;results/main_table.xlsx&quot;, excel append ctitle(&quot;Outcome 2&quot;)&#10;</pre></details>
- <details><summary><code>reporting.outreg2_excel_append.v1 [audit_action=retained_no_override]</code></summary><small>source=plugins/stata-research-guard/annotations/source_snapshots/community_reporting_guide_templates.do:16-18; source_kind=user_written_command_guide_derived_mechanics; source_sha256=08d5616661fd1ac5f3633564716e670cef95081353055ebc7f1a427187c4c206; code_sha256=92ec2d5d8ec5f3142a798310c511ef021b20600d5d8b8cf0cd4af6a421df9247</small><pre>* outreg2: later models append to the same declared workbook/sheet.&#10;regress y treat x1 x2 x3, vce(cluster cluster_id)&#10;outreg2 using &quot;results/table.xlsx&quot;, excel append ctitle(&quot;Model 2&quot;)&#10;</pre></details>

!mi(lg_rgdpna_percap_1)&#10;		gen Z_democxgdp_1=Z_democracy_1*lg_rgdpna_percap_1 if !mi(Z_democracy_1) &amp; !mi(lg_rgdpna_percap_1)&#10;		gen polity2xgdp_1 = polity2_1*lg_rgdpna_percap_1 if !mi(polity2_1) &amp; !mi(lg_rgdpna_percap_1)&#10;		gen Cheibobxgdp_1 = Democ_dummy_1*lg_rgdpna_percap_1 if !mi(Democ_dummy_1) &amp; !mi(lg_rgdpna_percap_1)&#10;		gen W_BdMxgdp_1 = W_BdM_1*lg_rgdpna_percap_1 if !mi(W_BdM_1) &amp; !mi(lg_rgdpna_percap_1)&#10;		gen W_eprxgdp_1 = W_epr_1*lg_rgdpna_percap_1 if !mi(W_epr_1) &amp; !mi(lg_rgdpna_percap_1)&#10;		gen VDemxgdp_1 = v2x_polyarchy_1*lg_rgdpna_percap_1 if !mi(v2x_polyarchy_1) &amp; !mi(lg_rgdpna_percap_1)&#10;&#10;		*First generate lags&#10;		xtset cid t&#10;		clonevar Z_democracy_2=Z_democracy_1&#10;		replace Z_democracy_2=l.Z_democracy_1&#10;		clonevar Z_democracy_3=Z_democracy_2&#10;		replace Z_democracy_3=l.Z_democracy_2&#10;		clonevar Z_democracy_4=Z_democracy_3&#10;		replace Z_democracy_4=l.Z_democracy_3&#10;		clonevar Z_democracy_5=Z_democracy_4&#10;		replace Z_democracy_5=l.Z_democracy_4	&#10;		clonevar Z2_polity2_2 = Z2_polity2_1&#10;		replace Z2_polity2_2=l.Z2_polity2_1&#10;		clonevar Z2_cheibob_2 = Z2_cheibob_1&#10;		replace Z2_cheibob_2=l.Z2_cheibob_1&#10;		clonevar Z2_W_BdM_2 = Z2_W_BdM_1&#10;		replace Z2_W_BdM_2 = l.Z2_W_BdM_1&#10;		clonevar Z2_W_epr_2 = Z2_W_epr_1&#10;		replace Z2_W_epr_2 = l.Z2_W_epr_1&#10;		clonevar Z2_v2x_polyarchy_2 = Z2_v2x_polyarchy_1&#10;		replace Z2_v2x_polyarchy_2 = l.Z2_v2x_polyarchy_1&#10;&#10;		*Generate interaction term with multiple lags of Z&#10;		gen Z_democxgdp_2=Z_democracy_2*lg_rgdpna_percap_1&#10;		gen Z_democxgdp_3=Z_democracy_3*lg_rgdpna_percap_1&#10;		gen Z_democxgdp_4=Z_democracy_4*lg_rgdpna_percap_1&#10;		gen Z_democxgdp_5=Z_democracy_5*lg_rgdpna_percap_1&#10;		gen Z2_polity2xgdp_2=Z2_polity2_2*lg_rgdpna_percap_1&#10;		gen Z2_cheibobxgdp_2=Z2_cheibob_2*lg_rgdpna_percap_1&#10;		gen Z2_W_BdMxgdp_2=Z2_W_BdM_2*lg_rgdpna_percap_1&#10;		gen Z2_W_eprxgdp_2=Z2_W_epr_2*lg_rgdpna_percap_1&#10;		gen Z2_VDemxgdp_2=Z2_v2x_polyarchy_2*lg_rgdpna_percap_1&#10;</pre></details>

- <details><summary><code>merge.teacher_year_attrition_flow.v1 [reference]</code></summary><small>source=corpus/packages/148522/A.6.TableA6_Teacher_Attrition.do:54-89; source_kind=deposited_research_code; source_sha256=f19cc8a831d0e8289296a3844124d95b32d2df21cf15ac98114a42de381972ac; code_sha256=bd13ccfa9a8b57994baa74eb8320fbceec076c1aeeda4f044bfeacf289931386</small><pre>* Collapses data to one observation per teacher and year&#10;collapse (max) teacher_gain_y1 teacher_loss_y1 teacher_any_y1 taught_gr* ///&#10;(mean) math_std mathI_std value_added M_value_added, by(teacher_id sy)&#10;&#10;tempfile working2&#10;save `working2&#x27;&#10;&#10;clear	&#10;use &quot;$data/long_term_testscores.dta&quot;&#10;&#10;gen teacher_any_y1 = 0&#10;replace teacher_any_y1 = 1 if teacher_gain_y1==1 &#124; teacher_loss_y1==1&#10;&#10;collapse (max) teacher_gain_y1 teacher_loss_y1 teacher_any_y1 ///&#10;(mean) mathI_std value_added M_value_added, by(teacher_id sy)&#10;&#10;append using `working2&#x27;&#10;&#10;* Create indicators for teachers showing up in our sample in a given year&#10;levelsof sy, local(levels) &#10;foreach l of local levels {&#10; gen I_`l&#x27; = 0&#10; replace I_`l&#x27; = 1 if sy == `l&#x27;&#10; bys teacher_id: egen in_sample_`l&#x27; = max(I_`l&#x27;)&#10; drop I_`l&#x27;&#10; }&#10;&#10;keep if in_sample_201011 == 1&#10;&#10;collapse (max) teacher_gain_y1 teacher_loss_y1 teacher_any_y1 taught_gr* ///&#10;(mean) math_std mathI_std value_added M_value_added in_sample_*, by(teacher_id)&#10;&#10;* Creates outcome for pooled data&#10;gen times_in_sample = in_sample_201112 + in_sample_201213 + in_sample_201314 ///&#10;+ in_sample_201415 + in_sample_201516&#10;gen frac_in_sample = times_in_sample / 5&#10;</pre></details>
- <details><summary><code>outlier.winsorize_two_sided_aggregate_wage.v1 [reference]</code></summary><small>source=corpus/packages/191751/script_dataforregressions.do:50-59; source_kind=deposited_research_code; source_sha256=17bc94ae771e9981454402904e4fab5b010da6730319ed715f731f632cb62afa; code_sha256=53fe2a056ef5bb57e11a8b824752eaa0be97a3343e2c65ce6b43ed5f642a1d72</small><pre>	preserve&#10;		use &quot;Data/clean/Panel_Wages.dta&quot;, clear&#10;		gen N=1&#10;		collapse (sum) All N, by(rbd)&#10;		gen WageSchool=All/N&#10;		winsor2 WageSchool, c(1 99) replace&#10;		keep rbd WageSchool&#10;		tempfile Wage&#10;		save `Wage&#x27;, replace&#10;	restore&#10;</pre></details>
- <details><summary><code>panel.cohort_anticipation_exit_filter.v1 [reference]</code></summary><small>source=corpus/packages/194561/code/10_data_preparation.do:177-227; source_kind=deposited_research_code; source_sha256=28d3bf8bde49cce093ad583a3f62a9089981154fdb71f35892d39a8d9c42cc38; code_sha256=3366f4a4b80e5943bee2feea8764f04f1d0caa3a04ecc1b1a51faaeb621d7008</small><pre>foreach dtaset in small medium large {&#10;&#10;	// load trade data&#10;	use ${usr_data}/data_`dtaset&#x27;.dta, clear&#10;	&#10;	* preliminary variable definitions&#10;	rename RTA_DGD RTA&#10;	egen id_ci = group(exporter)&#10;	egen id_cj = group(importer)&#10;&#10;	* set panel IDs&#10;	xtset id_ci_cj year, yearly&#10;&#10;	* determine treatment cohorts&#10;	egen first_treat=csgvar(RTA), tvar(year) ivar(id_ci_cj)&#10;&#10;	* shift RTA/WTO 3 years forward for anticipation effects&#10;	gen RTA_3 = F3.RTA&#10;	egen first_treat_3=csgvar(RTA_3), tvar(year) ivar(id_ci_cj)&#10;	gen WTO_3 = F3.WTO&#10;	&#10;	* define exclude dummy for three anticipation years&#10;	gen exclude = (first_treat-1==year &#124; first_treat-2==year &#124; first_treat-3==year)&#10;	&#10;	// drop always-treated units&#10;	drop if first_treat_3 == 1980&#10;&#10;	// drop exits&#10;	sort exporter importer year&#10;	gen D_RTA = 0&#10;	replace D_RTA = RTA-RTA[_n-1] if id_ci_cj==id_ci_cj[_n-1]&#10;	egen exit = min(D_RTA), by(id_ci_cj)&#10;	drop if exit==-1&#10;	drop exit D_RTA&#10;&#10;	// define 5-year interval&#10;	gen int_5yr = mod(year,5)&#10;	&#10;	// define border-time ID&#10;	gen brdr=1 if exporter!=importer&#10;	replace brdr=0 if brdr==.&#10;	egen brdr_time=group(brdr year)&#10;	&#10;	// define variables&#10;	gen lnDIST = ln(DIST)&#10;	gen lntrade = ln(trade)&#10;&#10;	// save data set&#10;	save ${usr_data}/data_sdid_`dtaset&#x27;.dta, replace&#10;&#10;}&#10;</pre></details>
